args.sql:
SELECT
    t5.risklev AS credit_category,
    t1.*
FROM
    credit.core_record AS t1
JOIN
    credit.employment_and_income AS t2
        ON t1.clientref = t2.emplcoreref
JOIN
    credit.expenses_and_assets AS t3
        ON t2.emplcoreref = t3.expemplref
JOIN
    credit.bank_and_transactions AS t4
        ON t3.expemplref = t4.bankexpref
JOIN
    credit.credit_and_compliance AS t5
        ON t4.bankexpref = t5.compbankref
JOIN
    credit.credit_accounts_and_history AS t6
        ON t5.compbankref = t6.histcompref
GROUP BY
    t5.risklev, t1.*;
